title: CBIC Announces Phased Rollout of SCMTR, 2018; Extends Transition Period Till January 31, 2027
content:
# CBIC Announces Phased Rollout of SCMTR, 2018; Extends Transition Period Till January 31, 2027

Ek important update hai for all stakeholders involved in sea cargo operations! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Sea Cargo Manifest and Transhipment Regulations (SCMTR), 2018 ke phased implementation ki announcement ki hai. Saath hi, transition period ko bhi extend kar diya gaya hai.

Yeh move trade ko without disruption naye digital framework par shift karne ke liye hai.

*   **What's Changing:** Old export messages ko phase-wise discontinue karke, ab SCMTR-compliant Cargo Information Message (CIM) filing mandatory ho jayega.
*   **Phased Implementation Starts From:** November 16, 2026.
*   **Extended Transition Period Till:** January 31, 2027.
*   **Circular Details:** This update has been issued via Circular No. 47/2026-Customs, dated November 1, 2026.
*   **No Penal Action:** Importantly, CBIC ne kaha hai ki is implementation phase ke dauran koi penal action nahi liya jayega.
*   **Reason for Extension:** Isse stakeholders, jaise custodians, terminal operators, aur trans-shippers ko SCMTR-compliant software aur message formats adopt karne ke liye extra time milega.
